def solve(N):
    return bin(sum(int(i) for i in str(N)))[2:]


# Unit test for function solve
def test_solve():
    assert solve(0) == "0"
    assert solve(5) == "101"
    assert solve(10) == "1"
    assert solve(123) == "110"       # 1 + 2 + 3 = 6
    assert solve(999) == "11011"     # 9 + 9 + 9 = 27
    assert solve(123456789) == "101101"  # Sum = 45
